flags.reason: misreads-source: The evidence's 0.1.78 check names mirror tag `v0.1.78` built from `5b6894b`. It never mentions a build '0.1.78-dbe0e02' or 'Component Bug #541'. It also says only that 'A 44 px `hitSlop` is set in code'. It does not say phones were tested or that they honour the slop. The gap adds a build id, a bug number and a phone-behaviour claim that the evidence does not support.

notes: 1) The evidence body above the '0.1.78 check' section describes 0.1.60. There, Active colours don't resolve, aria-checked is absent, there is no hit slop, and the default size is S. Its Limits say the guide 'must not show or claim a gold heart in the rendered examples'. The 0.1.78 check supersedes all of this (#168 fixed, aria-checked emitted, default M). The entry follows 0.1.78 correctly, but a human should update or retire the stale Limits so later reviewers aren't misled. 2) /configuration/11 faithfully restates the types fact /facts/props/12 ('loading true draws a same-size circular placeholder'). The 0.1.60 evidence says instead that `loading` 'renders a same-size circular skeleton only inside <SkeletonGroup loading>; on its own it renders nothing'. The 0.1.78 check did not re-test this, so standalone `loading` behaviour is unverified. 3) /examples/1 gives an already-saved toggle the label 'Save Nifty 50 Index Fund to favorites'. That matches the guide's sample labels, but a 'Save…' label on a saved toggle may read oddly to screen-reader users. The guide doesn't address it.
